evidence.detail: pagination uses this.state.page and search uses this.state.q — pure React state, no window.history / pushState / URLSearchParams anywhere in the file
six separate table JSX files (cardtable, decktable, headtoheadtable, leaderboardtable, matchtable, persontable) all extend the same Table/DataManager — all would need updating
issue body itself notes debouncing complexity: must not store every character of a search query ('f:p', 'f:pe', 'f:pen', …)

triage.notes: The work spans datamanager.jsx (state → URL sync, popstate handler, debouncing logic) plus all six concrete table components; well above the 150-line easy-fix bar. A library like react-router or use-query-params would reduce boilerplate but adds a dependency decision.
